newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: CM Telecom disposes stake in AIC Telecom.
newsitem.headline: CM Telecom disposes stake in AIC Telecom.

text.p: Singapore telecommunications company CM Telecom International Ltd (CMT) said on Wednesday CMT and its subsidiary had agreed to sell their stakes in AIC Telecom Ltd.

Under the agreement, CMT and Perfect Land Development Ltd (PLD) would sell their entire respective holding of 300,000 shares in AIC to Cho Chi Kui for HK$300,000. Each sale represents 30 percent of the issued share capital of AIC.
Following the share disposal, AIC will cease to be an associated ocmpany of CMT, a company statement said.
